deviations: The first launcher invocation stopped before any task spawned because `ROOT` was missing from its imports; the import was fixed, mathematical tests and the one-forward preflight were rerun, and a new manifest was frozen.

The initial validator rejected 8 completed artifacts because PPU and CPU float32 softmax differed by at most 1.1921e-7, just above its 1e-7 tolerance. Retry attempts stopped at artifact validation without retraining; ASD probabilities and four metrics were recomputed from the saved logits on CPU, then all 40 artifacts passed full validation.
The experiment JSONL log had 1346 NUL padding bytes removed; all 381 remaining lines parse as JSON.
historical_comparison_limits: Historical D4 is a read-only separate run; PPU trajectory drift is not controlled.
M3-M4 changes only the KL student's condition; the shared phenotype CE stays real-conditioned.
M2-M1 adds KL and is not a matched zero-information alignment test.
interpretation: Decision: **MIXED**. M3 AUC minus historical D4 is -0.09018298323593688 pp; M3-M1/M2/M4 AUC changes are 0.06904740416506794, 0.02623474199589637, and -0.05912547099568899 pp. M1-historical D4 AUC change is -0.1592303874010048 pp. M2-M1 changes the objective by adding KL and is not a zero-information alignment test. M3-M4 isolates the condition used by the new KL branch only; the shared phenotype CE remains real-conditioned. KL reduction alone is not evidence of diagnostic value. Sampled KL first-to-last was 0.001->0.261 for M2, 0.001->0.260 for M3, and 0.001->0.261 for M4; it did not decrease. Teacher-student agreement and student train accuracy stayed near 0.50, student entropy near the two-class maximum, and the shared phenotype prototype CE near chance, despite nonzero prototype geometry. KL gradients were zero at z_img and img_unet and nonzero at z_ph and ph_unet; a small RP-attention gradient shows an indirect path through the shared graph. Do not select PCDPA-X as the first MICCAI 2027 innovation candidate. A future study should first justify richer non-imaging inputs, then preregister multi-seed and independent-site confirmation; prior multi-seed D4 evidence also does not establish a stable gain or a high-quality teacher.

preflight.original_fusion_path_unchanged: No model/module/parameter modifications; read-only hooks capture both native GTUNet outputs.
limitations: The historical population graph is transductive and includes heldout nodes as in the original protocol.

probability_normalization.method: CPU float32 softmax recomputed from unchanged saved native logits; metrics recalculated
